exports.ownership: releases and clears library-owned bytes

exports.ownership: borrows callback and context until unregister, cancel, or destroy

exports.ownership: relays one Rust-owned opaque handle to the caller

exports.name: ra8_abi_chain_destroy

exports.ownership: releases PAL state and detaches the retained callback

exports.ownership: copies the caller MAC for the duration of the call
